description: Create/join four scoped workers, each running 250,000 dependent modular updates; verify every result.

description: Allocate 8,192 independently owned integers, traverse them, then destroy every owner.
contract: Same deterministic input, element counts and output digest. Allocation, initialization, work and destruction are timed. Unsigned arithmetic remains within range.
